name: Ntọala Enyemaka IT (Nkwadebe maka CompTIA A+)
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị foto ma ọ bụ ndepụta akụkụ kọmputa, ịmata akụkụ hardware ọ bụla bụ isi ma kwuo ihe ọ na-eme, ma nweta opekata mpe 8 n'ime 10 ziri ezi

Site n'iji kọmputa Windows ma ọ bụ Mac nke gị, ịgba ipconfig (ma ọ bụ lelee ntọala netwọk) na ping iji dee adreesị IP na default gateway ma nwalee njikọ ahụ, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka, ma kwuo ihe adreesị 169.254 pụtara
Site n'iji kọmputa nke gị, ịchọta ụdị sistemụ arụmọrụ, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ, mmemme na-arụ ọrụ na ọnọdụ mmelite site na ngwa dị n'ime ya, n'ime nkeji 10
Mgbe e nyere gị nsogbu kọmputa sitere n'aka onye ọrụ, itinye usoro idozi nsogbu nke CompTIA nwere nzọụkwụ isii n'ọrụ ma dee nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, na nzọụkwụ isii niile n'usoro ziri ezi

Mgbe e nyere gị oku ma ọ bụ ozi sitere n'aka onye ọrụ nwere nsogbu, ide tiketi help desk na azịza nkenke nwere nkwanye ugwu nye onye ọrụ ahụ, ma dejupụta ngalaba tiketi ọ bụla, na-enweghị ịta ụta ma ọ bụ okwu teknụzụ siri ike n'azịza ahụ
Site n'iji peeji ule CompTIA A+ ọfịshal, ide atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2, nke na-ekpuchi ngalaba ule ọ bụla na ibu ya, na oge ọmụmụ kwa izu

chapters.name: Isi 1: Ọrụ ahụ, hardware na netwọk

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ọrụ help desk na ule A+ abụọ ahụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Depụta ule A+ abụọ ahụ, koodu ha na isiokwu ndị bụ isi nke ọ bụla na-ekpuchi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji peeji ule CompTIA A+ ọfịshal, ị ga-enwe ike ide atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2, nke na-ekpuchi ngalaba ule ọ bụla na ibu ya, na oge ọmụmụ kwa izu.
Onye teknịshan enyemaka na-aza oku, chat na tiketi, na-edozi kọmputa na akaụntụ, na-edozi nsogbu a na-ahụkarị, ma mara mgbe ọ ga-enyefe nsogbu siri ike n'aka onye teknịshan ka ya. Aha ọrụ gụnyere help desk technician, IT support specialist, desktop support na field technician.
CompTIA A+ bụ asambodo mmalite a ma ama maka ọrụ a. Ọ bụ CompTIA na-enye ya, ọ bụghị ihe ọmụmụ a. Ị ga-agafe ule abụọ. Core 1 (220-1201) na-ekpuchi ngwaọrụ mkpanaka, netwọk, hardware, virtualization na cloud, na idozi nsogbu hardware na netwọk. Core 2 (220-1202) na-ekpuchi sistemụ arụmọrụ, nchekwa, idozi nsogbu sọftwụia na usoro ọrụ. Ị nwere ike ide ha n'usoro ọ bụla.
Mgbe anyị lelere n'October 2026, ule ọ bụla nwere ruo ajụjụ 90 n'ime nkeji 90, ya na ajụjụ nhọrọ, drag-and-drop na performance-based (obere ọrụ aka). CompTIA na-atụ aro ihe dị ka ọnwa 12 nke ahụmahụ aka, mana nke a bụ naanị ndụmọdụ. Ule, ọnụahịa na ụdị ule na-agbanwe, ya mere lelee peeji ọfịshal mgbe niile tupu i debanye aha.
Ule ọ bụla na-edepụta ngalaba (domain), ya bụ isiokwu, na ibu nke ọ bụla, ya bụ òkè ule ahụ isiokwu ahụ were. Oge ọmụmụ gị kwesịrị ịgbaso ibu ndị ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee peeji CompTIA A+ ọfịshal.
- Meghee peeji ule Core 1 na Core 2.
- Dee koodu ule ọ bụla na ngalaba ya na ibu ha.
- Chọta ọnụahịa dị ugbu a na ụzọ e si ede ule (ebe ule ma ọ bụ n'ịntanetị) na saịtị ọfịshal.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Help desk: otu ndị mmadụ na-akpọtụrụ mgbe teknụzụ ha anaghị arụ ọrụ.
- Asambodo (certification): akwụkwọ ikike ị na-enweta site n'ịgafe ule, nke na-egosi na i nwere nkà ụfọdụ.
- Ngalaba (domain): isiokwu nke ule. Ibu ya bụ òkè ajụjụ gbasara ya.
- Performance-based question: ọrụ ule ebe ị na-eme ihe, dị ka ijikọ ntọala ma ọ bụ idozi nhazi, kama ịhọrọ otu azịza.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CompTIA A+ certification (official page)
- CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201) exam details
- CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202) exam details
- US Bureau of Labor Statistics: Computer Support Specialists
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee peeji Core 1 na Core 2 ọfịshal. N'akwụkwọ, mee kọlụm abụọ, otu maka ule ọ bụla. Dee koodu ule ahụ, wee dee ngalaba ọ bụla na ibu ya. Gbaa okirikiri gburugburu ngalaba kacha ibu n'ule ọ bụla: ebe ahụ ka ị ga-etinye oge ọmụmụ kacha ukwuu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha ule A+ abụọ ahụ, koodu ha na ngalaba ha ndị bụ isi, ma chọta nkọwa dị ugbu a na peeji ọfịshal.

check.q: Ule ole ka ị ga-agafe iji nweta CompTIA A+?
options: Ọ dịghị; ihe ọmụmụ a na-enye ya
check.why: A+ chọrọ ma Core 1 ma Core 2; ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị naanị.

check.q: Ebee ka i kwesịrị ịlele ọnụahịa A+ na ụdị ule dị ugbu a?
options: Ihe e dere na forum n'afọ gara aga
check.why: Ọnụahịa na ụdị ule na-agbanwe; peeji ọfịshal bụ naanị ebe a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: N'ime kọmputa: akụkụ hardware ndị bụ isi
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Mata akụkụ hardware ndị bụ isi nke kọmputa ma kwuo ihe nke ọ bụla na-eme.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị foto ma ọ bụ ndepụta akụkụ kọmputa, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata akụkụ hardware ọ bụla bụ isi ma kwuo ihe ọ na-eme, ma nweta opekata mpe 8 n'ime 10 ziri ezi.
Hardware bụ akụkụ ndị ị pụrụ imetụ aka. Motherboard bụ bọọdụ bụ isi ihe niile na-abanye na ya. CPU (processor) na-eche echiche. RAM (ebe nchekwa nwa oge) na-ejide ihe ị na-arụ ugbu a, ọ na-ehichapụ mgbe ọkụ gbanyụrụ. Ebe nchekwa (storage) na-edebe faịlụ gị mgbe ọkụ gbanyụrụ: SSD (solid-state drive, na-agba ọsọ, enweghị akụkụ na-akpali akpali) ma ọ bụ HDD (hard disk drive, na-adị nwayọọ, nwere diski na-agba gburugburu).
Power supply (PSU) na-agbanwe ọkụ si na mgbidi ka ọ bụrụ ọkụ akụkụ ndị ahụ na-eji. Graphics card (GPU) na-ese foto na ihuenyo; ọtụtụ kọmputa nwere graphics wuru n'ime CPU. Ọdụ (port) dị n'èzí gụnyere USB (USB-A na USB-C dị obere nke ị pụrụ ịtụgharị), HDMI na DisplayPort maka ihuenyo, na Ethernet maka netwọk waya.
Ihe ịrịba ama a na-ahụkarị na help desk: kọmputa na-adị nwayọọ mgbe ọtụtụ mmemme mepere emepe nwere ike ịchọ RAM karịa; kọmputa na-ewe ogologo oge ịmalite nwere ike inwe hard drive fọrọ nke nta ka ọ jupụta ma ọ bụ nke ochie.
Nchekwa buru ụzọ: ọ dịghị mkpa imeghe kọmputa maka ihe ọmụmụ a. Onye teknịshan na-agbanyụ kọmputa ma wepụ ya na ọkụ mgbe niile tupu o meghee ya, na-eyi anti-static wrist strap, anaghịkwa emeghe power supply ma ọ bụ batrị zara aza.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Hardware: akụkụ kọmputa ndị a na-ahụ anya ma metụ aka.
- CPU: processor; akụkụ na-agba mmemme ma na-agụkọ ọnụ.
- RAM: ebe nchekwa nwa oge na-ejide mmemme na faịlụ mepere emepe; ọ na-ehichapụ mgbe ọkụ gbanyụrụ.
- SSD / HDD: draịvụ nchekwa na-edebe faịlụ mgbe ọkụ gbanyụrụ. SSD na-agba ọsọ karịa, enweghịkwa akụkụ na-akpali akpali.
- Motherboard: bọọdụ sekit bụ isi na-ejikọ akụkụ niile.
- ESD: electrostatic discharge: obere ọkụ static nwere ike imebi akụkụ kọmputa.
Nwaa ugbu a: Lee kọmputa gị naanị site n'èzí. Depụta ọdụ ọ bụla ị hụrụ ma kpọọ ya aha (USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, Ethernet, headphone). Wee, na Windows meghee Settings > System > About, ma ọ bụ na Mac meghee Apple menu > About This Mac, ma dee processor gị na RAM (ebe nchekwa) ole kọmputa ahụ nwere.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha akụkụ kọmputa ndị bụ isi, kwuo ihe nke ọ bụla na-eme, ma chọta processor na RAM nke kọmputa gị.

check.q: Kedu akụkụ na-edebe faịlụ gị mgbe a gbanyụrụ kọmputa?
options: SSD ma ọ bụ hard drive
check.why: Ebe nchekwa (SSD ma ọ bụ HDD) na-edebe faịlụ; RAM na-ehichapụ mgbe ọkụ gbanyụrụ.

check.q: Tupu imeghe kọmputa desktop, gịnị ka onye teknịshan na-ebu ụzọ eme?
options: Gbanyụọ ya ma wepụ ya na ọkụ
Wepụ batrị mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ
Fesa mmiri ka ọ jụọ oyi
check.why: Buru ụzọ gbanyụọ ma wepụ na ọkụ; nke a na-echebe gị na akụkụ ndị ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ntọala netwọk: adreesị IP, ipconfig na ping
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Lelee njikọ netwọk kọmputa site na ipconfig na ping ma dee ihe ị hụrụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji kọmputa Windows ma ọ bụ Mac nke gị, ị ga-enwe ike ịgba ipconfig (ma ọ bụ lelee ntọala netwọk) na ping iji dee adreesị IP na default gateway ma nwalee njikọ ahụ, n'enweghị onye nyere gị aka, ma kwuo ihe adreesị 169.254 pụtara.
Ngwaọrụ ọ bụla dị na netwọk na-enweta adreesị IP, dị ka adreesị okporo ụzọ maka data. N'ụlọ, ọ na-adịkarị ka 192.168.x.x ma ọ bụ 10.x.x.x. Router gị na-ekesa adreesị ndị a n'onwe ya site n'ọrụ a na-akpọ DHCP. Default gateway bụ adreesị router: ọnụ ụzọ si na netwọk ụlọ gị gaa n'ịntanetị.
Ọ bụrụ na kọmputa Windows gosiri adreesị na-amalite na 169.254, o nweghị ike inweta adreesị site na DHCP. Nke ahụ bụ ihe ịrịba ama dị ukwuu: lelee waya ma ọ bụ Wi-Fi, wee lelee router.
Ngwa abụọ onye teknịshan ọ bụla na-eji: ipconfig na-egosi adreesị IP gị na default gateway (na Windows, meghee Command Prompt ma pịnye ipconfig). ping na-ezipu obere ozi nnwale na ngwaọrụ ọzọ ma gosi ma ọ zara. Buru ụzọ ping default gateway; ọ bụrụ na nke ahụ rụrụ ọrụ, ping weebụsaịtị dị ka comptia.org.
Mee omume ndị a naanị na kọmputa na netwọk nke gị. Ụfọdụ kọmputa ọba akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ nke ebe ọrụ na-egbochi command prompt; ọ bụrụ otu ahụ, jiri ntọala netwọk chọta adreesị IP gị kama.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Windows: pịa igodo Windows, pịnye cmd ma meghee Command Prompt. Mac: meghee Terminal.
- Windows: pịnye ipconfig ma pịa Enter. Dee IPv4 address na default gateway. Mac: chọta adreesị IP na router na System Settings > Network.
- Pịnye ping sochiri adreesị gateway gị, dịka ọmụmaatụ ping 192.168.1.1, ma pịa Enter.
- Na Mac, pịa Control na C ka ping kwụsị.
- Gụọ ihe ọ gosiri: azịza (replies) pụtara na njikọ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ; "timed out" ma ọ bụ "unreachable" pụtara na ọ naghị arụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Adreesị IP: nọmba na-amata ngwaọrụ na netwọk.
- DHCP: ọrụ ahụ, nke na-adịkarị na router, na-enye ngwaọrụ adreesị IP ha n'onwe ya.
- Default gateway: adreesị router; ụzọ si na netwọk gị pụọ n'ịntanetị.
- ipconfig: iwu (command) Windows na-egosi ntọala netwọk gị.
- ping: iwu na-anwale ma ngwaọrụ ọzọ na-aza site na netwọk.
- Router: igbe na-ejikọ netwọk ụlọ gị na ịntanetị.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201) exam details
Nwaa ugbu a: Na kọmputa nke gị, gbasoo nzọụkwụ ndị ahụ. Dee adreesị IP gị na default gateway, wee ping gateway ma ping comptia.org. Dee "ọ na-arụ" ma ọ bụ "ọ naghị arụ" maka nke ọ bụla. Debe ndetu a maka ọrụ ikpeazụ gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịchọta adreesị IP gị na default gateway, nwalee njikọ site na ping, ma kwuo ihe adreesị 169.254 pụtara.

check.q: Laptop Windows na-egosi adreesị IP 169.254.20.5. Gịnị ka nke a na-agwa gị?
options: O nwetaghị adreesị site na DHCP
check.why: Adreesị 169.254 pụtara na ngwaọrụ ahụ erughị DHCP, ya mere lelee njikọ na router.

check.q: Kedu iwu na-egosi adreesị IP na default gateway nke kọmputa Windows?
check.why: ipconfig na-egosi ntọala netwọk gị; ping na-anwale njikọ.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Sistemụ, idozi nsogbu na atụmatụ gị

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ngwa sistemụ arụmọrụ ị na-eji kwa ụbọchị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Chọta ụdị sistemụ, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ, mmemme na-arụ ọrụ na ọnọdụ mmelite na kọmputa nke gị.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji kọmputa nke gị, ị ga-enwe ike ịchọta ụdị sistemụ arụmọrụ, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ, mmemme na-arụ ọrụ na ọnọdụ mmelite site na ngwa dị n'ime ya, n'ime nkeji 10.
Sistemụ arụmọrụ (OS) bụ mmemme bụ isi na-agba kọmputa: Windows, macOS, Linux, ma ọ bụ na ekwentị Android na iOS. A+ Core 2 na-atụ anya ka ị mara ụzọ gị n'ime ha.
Na Windows: Settings > System > About na-egosi ụdị ya. Settings > System > Storage na-egosi ebe fọdụrụ. Task Manager (pịa Ctrl + Shift + Esc) na-egosi mmemme na-arụ ọrụ na otu CPU na memory si arụsi ọrụ ike; ị nwere ike imechi mmemme kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ ebe ahụ. Settings > Windows Update na-egosi ma mmelite na-eche.
Na Mac: Apple menu > About This Mac na-egosi ụdị ya. Activity Monitor (chọọ ya site na Spotlight) na-egosi mmemme na-arụ ọrụ. System Settings > General > Software Update na-egosi mmelite. Storage dị n'okpuru System Settings > General > Storage.
Omume nchekwa ọma bụ akụkụ nke ọrụ ahụ: wụnye mmelite, hapụ antivirus dị n'ime ya ka ọ na-arụ (Microsoft Defender na Windows), jiri akaụntụ nkịtị (ọ bụghị admin) maka ọrụ kwa ụbọchị, ma kpọchie ihuenyo mgbe ị na-apụ (igodo Windows + L na Windows).
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọta aha OS na ụdị ya.
- Chọta ebe nchekwa ole fọdụrụ.
- Meghee Task Manager ma ọ bụ Activity Monitor ma chọta mmemme na-eji memory kacha ukwuu.
- Lelee mmelite.
- Kpọchie ihuenyo gị, wee meghee ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Sistemụ arụmọrụ (OS): sọftwụia bụ isi na-agba kọmputa ma ọ bụ ekwentị, dị ka Windows ma ọ bụ macOS.
- Task Manager: ngwa Windows na-egosi mmemme na-arụ ọrụ ma na-ekwe ka i mechie nke kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ.
- Activity Monitor: ngwa Mac na-egosi mmemme na-arụ ọrụ.
- Akaụntụ admin: akaụntụ nwere ike ịwụnye sọftwụia ma gbanwee ntọala. Ọrụ kwa ụbọchị kwesịrị iji akaụntụ nkịtị.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202) exam details
Nwaa ugbu a: Na kọmputa nke gị, dee: aha OS na ụdị ya, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ, mmemme na-eji memory kacha ukwuu ugbu a, na ma mmelite ọ bụla na-eche. Tinye nke a na ndetu netwọk gị sitere na Nkuzi 3. Ugbu a i nwere ọtụtụ n'ime akụkụ 2 nke ọrụ ikpeazụ gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iji ngwa dị n'ime kọmputa lelee ụdị ya, ebe nchekwa, mmemme na-arụ ọrụ na mmelite.

check.q: Mmemme kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ na Windows. Kedu ngwa na-ekwe ka i mechie ya?
check.why: Task Manager na-egosi mmemme na-arụ ọrụ ma nwee ike imechi nke kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ.

check.q: Kedu omume ka mma maka ọrụ kwa ụbọchị?
options: Iji akaụntụ nkịtị ma hapụ mmelite ka ọ na-arụ
Ịgbanyụ antivirus ka ọ gbaa ọsọ
check.why: Akaụntụ nkịtị na mmelite dị ọhụrụ na-ebelata mmebi ma ọ bụrụ na ihe mebiri.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Usoro idozi nsogbu nwere nzọụkwụ isii
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Tinye nzọụkwụ isii nke CompTIA maka idozi nsogbu n'otu nsogbu, n'usoro.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị nsogbu kọmputa sitere n'aka onye ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike itinye usoro idozi nsogbu nke CompTIA nwere nzọụkwụ isii n'ọrụ ma dee nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, na nzọụkwụ isii niile n'usoro ziri ezi.
Ndị teknịshan ọma anaghị akọ nkọ. Ha na-agbaso usoro. Ebumnuche A+ na-eji nzọụkwụ isii: 1. Mata nsogbu ahụ. 2. Chepụta echiche gbasara ihe nwere ike ịkpata ya (jụọ ihe doro anya). 3. Nwalee echiche ahụ ka ịchọta ihe kpatara ya. 4. Mee atụmatụ ma dozie ya. 5. Hụ na sistemụ niile na-arụ ọrụ ma, ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-enyere aka, mee ihe ga-egbochi ka ọ ghara imeghachi. 6. Dee ihe ị hụrụ, ihe i mere na ihe si na ya pụta.
Nzọụkwụ 1 pụtara ịjụ onye ọrụ ajụjụ: Gịnị mere? Kedu mgbe ọ malitere? Ọ dị ihe gbanwere? Ọ nwere ozi njehie (error message)? Chekwaa data dị mkpa (back up) tupu i gbanwee ihe ọ bụla.
Nzọụkwụ 2 pụtara ịmalite n'ihe dị mfe nwere ike ịkpata ya: Ọ jikọrọ na ọkụ? Wi-Fi gbanyere? E malitegharịrị ya (restart)? Ọ bụrụ na echiche mbụ gị ezighi ezi, chepụta nke ọhụrụ ma nwalee ọzọ, ma ọ bụ bulie ya elu (escalate), ya bụ nyefee ya onye teknịshan ka gị.
Ọmụmaatụ: printa anaghị ebipụta. Echiche: ọ nọ offline. Nnwale: ihuenyo printa na-egosi na akwụkwọ rapaara n'ime ya (paper jam). Ndozi: wepụ akwụkwọ ahụ n'enweghị nsogbu. Nlele: bipụta peeji nnwale. Dee ya: "Akwụkwọ rapaara na tray 2, e wepụrụ ya, e bipụtara peeji nnwale."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mata nsogbu ahụ: jụọ ajụjụ, chekwaa data.
- Chepụta echiche gbasara ihe kpatara ya: malite n'ihe doro anya.
- Nwalee echiche ahụ. O zighi ezi? Chepụta nke ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ bulie ya elu.
- Mee atụmatụ ma dozie ya.
- Hụ na ọ na-arụ ọrụ ma gbochie ka ọ ghara imeghachi ma ọ bụrụ na i nwere ike.
- Dee ihe ị hụrụ, ihe i mere na ihe si na ya pụta.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Idozi nsogbu (troubleshooting): ịchọta na idozi ihe kpatara nsogbu nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ.
- Echiche gbasara ihe kpatara ya: ihe kacha mma i chere na-akpata nsogbu ahụ.
- Bulie elu (escalate): nyefee nsogbu onye nwere nkà ma ọ bụ ikike karịa.
- Dee ya (document): dee ihe ị hụrụ na ihe i mere, ọtụtụ mgbe n'ime tiketi.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201) exam details
Nwaa ugbu a: Họrọ nsogbu n'ezie i nwere (laptop na-adị nwayọọ, enweghị Wi-Fi, ekwentị na-anaghị chaji) ma ọ bụ jiri: "Onye ọrụ enweghị ike ijikọ na Wi-Fi mgbe ọ gbanwere tebụl." Dee nzọụkwụ isii niile maka ya n'akwụkwọ, ya na ihe ị ga-ajụ, lelee ma dee na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike idozi nsogbu site na nzọụkwụ isii nke idozi nsogbu ma dee nke ọ bụla.

check.q: Kedu nzọụkwụ MBỤ nke idozi nsogbu?
options: Hụ na sistemụ niile na-arụ ọrụ
check.why: Ị ga-aghọta nsogbu ahụ tupu i chee ihe kpatara ya.

check.q: I doziri nsogbu ahụ. Gịnị na-abịa tupu ide ya?
options: Hụ na sistemụ niile na-arụ ọrụ
Chekwaa data na nke mbụ ya
check.why: Nzọụkwụ 5 bụ ihụ na ihe niile na-arụ ọrụ; nzọụkwụ 6 bụ ide ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Tiketi, ikwurịta okwu na ndị ọrụ, na atụmatụ ọmụmụ A+ gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Dee tiketi help desk zuru ezu na atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule A+ nwere ụbọchị.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị oku ma ọ bụ ozi sitere n'aka onye ọrụ nwere nsogbu, ị ga-enwe ike ide tiketi help desk na azịza nkenke nwere nkwanye ugwu nye onye ọrụ ahụ, ma dejupụta ngalaba tiketi ọ bụla, na-enweghị ịta ụta ma ọ bụ okwu teknụzụ siri ike n'azịza ahụ. Site n'iji peeji ule CompTIA A+ ọfịshal, ị ga-enwe ike ide atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule nwere ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2, nke na-ekpuchi ngalaba ule ọ bụla na ibu ya, na oge ọmụmụ kwa izu.
Tiketi bụ ndekọ nke otu nsogbu. Tiketi ọma nwere: aha onye ọrụ na otu e si akpọtụrụ ya (n'ọrụ n'ezie, site na sistemụ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ), ngwaọrụ ahụ, nchịkọta nkenke, nkọwa na ozi njehie ọ bụla, priority (otu o si dị ngwa), nzọụkwụ e mere, na ihe si na ya pụta. Dee ya ka onye teknịshan ọzọ nwee ike iburu ya ma ghọta ya.
Otu i si ekwu okwu dị mkpa dị ka ndozi ahụ. Gee ntị n'egbochighị ya, kwughachi nsogbu ahụ, jiri okwu dị mfe, ataghị onye ọrụ ụta, gwa ya oge ị ga-enye ya ozi ọhụrụ, ma soro ya kwado na edozila ya tupu i mechie tiketi. Debe ozi ya na nzuzo.
Ugbu a, hazie ule gị. Jiri ibu ngalaba i dere na Nkuzi 1. Họrọ ụbọchị ebumnuche maka ule ọ bụla. Nye ngalaba ndị ka ibu izu karịa. Jiri omume n'efu: akwụkwọ exam objectives n'efu nke CompTIA, kọmputa nke gị, na nnwale ihe ọmụma ndị dị ebe a. Ọtụtụ ndị na-amụ awa 5 ruo 10 kwa izu; họrọ ihe dabara ndụ gị ma dee ya.
Tupu i debanye aha, lelee peeji ọfịshal maka ọnụahịa dị ugbu a, mmemme mbelata ọnụahịa ọ bụla na ụzọ e si ede ule. Ụlọ ọrụ workforce, mmemme ndị agha mbụ na mmemme re-entry na-enyere aka mgbe ụfọdụ n'ụgwọ ule, ya mere jụọ nke gị.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Tiketi: dejupụta onye ọrụ, ngwaọrụ, nchịkọta, nkọwa, priority, nzọụkwụ e mere na ihe si na ya pụta.
- Azịza: kelee ya, kwuo ihe ị hụrụ n'okwu dị mfe, kwuo ihe ga-esote na mgbe ọ ga-eme.
- Atụmatụ: dee ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2.
- Depụta ngalaba ọ bụla na ibu ya na izu ole ị na-enye ya.
- Dee awa ọmụmụ gị kwa izu na ebe ị ga-amụ ihe.
- Lelee peeji ọfịshal maka ọnụahịa na ụzọ e si ede ule; jụọ mmemme dị nso maka enyemaka n'ụgwọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Tiketi: ndekọ e dere ede nke otu arịrịọ enyemaka, site na mmalite ruo na njedebe.
- Priority: otu tiketi si dị ngwa, ọtụtụ mgbe low, medium, high ma ọ bụ critical.
- Atụmatụ ọmụmụ: usoro oge e dere ede nke ihe ị ga-amụ, mgbe ị ga-amụ ya, na ụbọchị ule gị.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CompTIA A+ certification (official page)
- CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201) exam details
- CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202) exam details
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: dee tiketi maka nsogbu Nkuzi 5 gị na ngalaba niile na nzọụkwụ isii ahụ, ya na azịza ahịrịokwu abụọ nye onye ọrụ. Tinye ndetu kọmputa gị sitere na Nkuzi 3 na 4 n'otu peeji. Wee dee atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule A+ gị: ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2, ngalaba ọ bụla na ibu ya, na awa gị kwa izu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide tiketi enyemaka doro anya, zaa onye ọrụ n'ụzọ nwere nkwanye ugwu, ma gbasoo atụmatụ gị nwere ụbọchị ruo n'ule A+ abụọ ahụ.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ndetu kọmputa Ụdị OS, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ ma ọ bụ mmelite adịghị. Ọ na-edepụta OS na ụdị ya, ebe nchekwa fọdụrụ, mmemme kacha eji memory na ọnọdụ mmelite. Ọ na-edepụtakwa processor na RAM ma kwuo ihe ha pụtara maka ọsọ kọmputa. Nlele netwọk Enweghị adreesị IP ma ọ bụ gateway, ma ọ bụ a nwaleghị ping. Ọ na-edekọ adreesị IP na gateway na ihe si na ping gateway na weebụsaịtị pụta. Ọ na-akọwa ihe nsonaazụ ga-apụta ma ọ bụrụ na otu ping adaghị, gụnyere adreesị 169.254. Nzọụkwụ idozi nsogbu Nzọụkwụ adịghị ma ọ bụ ha adịghị n'usoro, ma ọ bụ ndozi ahụ bụ nkọ. Nzọụkwụ isii niile n'usoro, ya na ihe a jụrụ, e nwalere na e mere. O nwere echiche nke abụọ ma ọ bụ ebe a ga-ebuli ya elu, na ụzọ ga-egbochi ka ọ ghara imeghachi. Tiketi na azịza Tiketi edoghị anya ma ọ bụ azịza ahụ na-ata onye ọrụ ụta ma ọ bụ na-eji okwu teknụzụ siri ike. E dejupụtara ngalaba tiketi ọ bụla; azịza ahụ nwere nkwanye ugwu, dị mfe ma na-ekwu ihe ga-esote. Onye ọzọ nwere ike ịgbaso tiketi ahụ n'ajụghị ajụjụ ọ bụla. Atụmatụ ọmụmụ na ule Enweghị ụbọchị, ma ọ bụ ngalaba adịghị. Ụbọchị ebumnuche maka Core 1 na Core 2, ngalaba ọ bụla na ibu ya, awa kwa izu. Atụmatụ ahụ na-enye ngalaba ndị ka ibu izu karịa ma kpọọ aha ebe a ga-elele ọnụahịa na nweta enyemaka n'ụgwọ. Okwu hardware A kpọrọ akụkụ hardware aha n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi na ndetu ma ọ bụ tiketi. A kpọrọ akụkụ na ọdụ aha nke ọma. Ọ na-ejikọ ihe ịrịba ama na akụkụ nwere ike ịkpata ya, dịka ọmụmaatụ ịdị nwayọọ mgbe ọtụtụ mmemme mepere na RAM pere mpe. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Kedu nchịkọta tiketi kacha baa uru?
options: "Laptop enweghị ike ijikọ na Wi-Fi ọfịs kemgbe ọ kwagara na tebụl 14; njehie: no internet."
check.why: Ọ na-akpọ aha ngwaọrụ, nsogbu, mgbe ọ malitere na njehie ahụ, n'enweghị ịta ụta.

check.q: Core 1 nwere ngalaba bara 28% na otu bara 11%. Kedu otu i kwesịrị isi hazie?
check.why: Ibu ka ukwuu pụtara ajụjụ karịa, ya mere ha kwesịrị oge ọmụmụ karịa.
